summary.text: Michelle Winder is the Democratic candidate for the Texas House of Representatives, District 99, in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging Republican incumbent Charlie Geren.
She is a retired railroad conductor and U.S. Army National Guard veteran.

paragraphs.text: Michelle Winder, also known as Lola, graduated from Arlington Heights High School and served in the U.S. Army National Guard from 1984 to 1990.
Her career experience includes working as a railroad conductor.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a retired railroad union employee and veteran who grew up in Fort Worth.
She listed public schools and opposition to school vouchers, water, and healthcare among her key campaign messages.
